title: Low battery voltage
fullDescription:
E01 on Drive Medical Scout / Spitfire scooters indicates low battery. Performance reduced until charged.

Charge 8-10 hours fully.

Safety note: do not deep-discharge batteries.

fixSteps.title: Charge
fixSteps.instruction: Plug in charger until indicator green.

whenToCallPro: For medical devices, contact manufacturer support or your healthcare provider before attempting service
videoSearchQuery: drive medical scout E01 battery low

title: Battery connection fault
fullDescription:
E02 means battery cable or terminal problem. Check connections and corrosion.

Tighten, clean, test.

Safety note: disconnect before servicing.

fixSteps.title: Inspect
fixSteps.instruction: Open compartment; clean and tighten terminals.

whenToCallPro: For medical devices, contact manufacturer support or your healthcare provider before attempting service

faq.a: Keep terminals dry; apply dielectric grease.

title: Motor fault
fullDescription:
E03 indicates motor or wiring fault. Inspect motor plug; dealer for further diagnosis.

Safety note: do not operate if motor is faulty.

fixSteps.title: Reseat plug
fixSteps.instruction: Inspect motor connector under scooter body.

whenToCallPro: Contact Drive Medical dealer for motor service

title: Brake release / freewheel active
fullDescription:
E04 means freewheel is set to push mode. Return to drive position.

Safety note: freewheel disables brake.
whenToCallPro: For medical devices, contact manufacturer support or your healthcare provider before attempting service

faq.a: Typically rear of scooter near motor.

title: Charger inhibit active
fullDescription:
E05 prevents driving while charger is connected.

Unplug charger fully.

Safety note: safety feature.
whenToCallPro: For medical devices, contact manufacturer support or your healthcare provider before attempting service

faq.a: Avoids cable damage and electrical hazard.

title: Throttle out of neutral
fullDescription:
E06 appears when throttle is engaged at power-on.

Release throttle, power cycle.

Safety note: persistent code means sensor fault.

fixSteps.title: Reset
fixSteps.instruction: Release throttle; power off 10 sec; power on.

faq.a: Rarely; cold can stiffen throttle spring.

title: Controller fault
fullDescription:
E07 indicates main controller fault — requires dealer diagnosis and typically controller replacement.

Safety note: do not drive.

fixSteps.title: Service
fixSteps.instruction: Power cycle; if code persists, contact dealer.

faq.a: Check purchase date — typical warranty 1-2 years.

title: Thermal cutout
fullDescription:
E08 means thermal cutout engaged — wait for cool down.

Park in shade 30-60 min.

Safety note: avoid continuous slopes.
whenToCallPro: For medical devices, contact manufacturer support or your healthcare provider before attempting service

faq.a: Stay within weight limit; avoid long steep slopes.
